Dialogue:
Look at me go!
I could do this all day.
I'd rather you didn't.
That's not what those suits are designed for, you know.
What am I looking at, exactly?
It's still too early to tell. We lack sufficient data.
Hghnya! Hghnya!
Take care not to hammer any toes!
Bring to bear the power of a hundred carrots!
M-May I please have an upgrade to my suit?
Requesting reinforcements...
We must proceed with all due caution!
I shouldn't touch this, should I...
Hmm...
I could spend my life recording data and die a happy man.
There should be viable materials around here...
Be careful when approaching the crystal!
Is this another door?
This way!
An incredible discovery!
So, we might also need...
Fascinating...
What clear water... An effect of mineral composition?
Emerald as sun-kissed leaves in summertime, and lustrous as my own eyes.
...I'll just put down “green.”
Time to get going.
Come on through.

I call 'em suit squats!
Just takes a bit o' calibration.
Impeccable form!
If you're lost, just raise your paw!
They're planning to extend the Cosmoliner through here?
Yep. Prioritizing access to the deepest sections, apparently.
Watch out for rocks and other debris!

An activation module?
Shouldn't be a problem.
Keep it moving.
Such spacious tunnels!
Looking good!
Steady...!
Keep at it, and I'll reward you with three carrots!
That such pristine ruins could slumber underground for so long...
Understood. Many thanks for the report!
Never thought I'd get to take a break in an ancient ruin...
Now recording...
How does this work, I wonder...?
I dunno, but it's pretty!
An “Oizys,” indeed!
This landscape feeds my aesthetic hunger!
You know the drill! Get those joints moving!
One, two! Three, four!
Five, six! Seven, eight!
Time to fix the schedule... \\<sigh>
For our records...
Bizarre planet, eh?
I'm just grateful for these new suits.

Pity the food's still...
Urp...
How do you reckon we'll improve the base?
I'd rather we improve the food...
I won't lose to this star's infernal dust.
We'll polish till you're shiny!
How shall I help?
Can't stop, won't stop!
Everyone, keep up the good work!
Aye aye!
All according to plan!
Efficiency, folks! Efficiency!
Doing a magnificent job, if I do say so myself.
Requires a light touch, but I don't hate this sort of work...
Like this...
Careful... Careful...
Damned gravitational anomalies...
This way!
This way!
Your home away from home!
Everyone smile!
Hip-hip...
Hooray!
We seem to be on schedule...
So far, so good!
Oizyyys!
All right! Say “Oizys”!
Good ol' habitation module.
Starts to feel like home, after a while.
Just you and me, buddy. We did good.
Feel free to cross our unquestionably sturdy bridge!
What incredible skill you possess, little one!
Either we keep energy flowing into that bridge, or...
I hope these fluffy lovelies settle in well...
It was here, last I checked...
Just use mine already.
I-I can reach! I just need a lift!
Reckon this is sturdy enough?
Just a little more, I think.
Understood!
The best carrots are those enjoyed in secrecy.
Tee hee! Don't tell!
Our current supply of energy...
Regular maintenance is critical.
Exciting times!
That's the spirit! We can do this!
Safety first, everyone!
It's all about the details.
Hehehe... I'm a genius...
Good enough for initiative work!
Straight lines... Careful...
These overly delicate controls... Grh!
Hm? We seem to be missing one again...
Where could they have gone this time?
Now, see here! You're supposed to be working!

Sleep mode engaged.
Powering down...
Our sustainability is peerless!
Everyone pose!
Get my good side, will you?
Big smiles, everyone!
A steady supply of fresh drinking water? Yes, please.
I'm sure your coffee will taste all the better for it, too.
The only perch I'll ever need.
Is there nothing I can spread on this?
Other than carrot paste, you mean?
And carrot jam!
Any wear that needs maintenance?
The batteries look all right...
No nicks in these blades... I think we're fine.
Let's check the schedule...
So shiny!
I won't let even a speck of dust escape me!
Careful and precise!
Two vacuums weigh nothing at all! This suit is a marvel!
Easy does it...
This suit is incredible! I can do anything!
Our base is looking better than ever!
Incorporating preservation into our renovations was a brilliant idea.
Took no little effort to execute, though...
I'll stimulate your aether! Just watch me!

I am the suit...
The suit is me...
We are UNSTOPPABLE!
Gotta thank our alchemists for brewing us this spray!
The Euhedron is as good as new!
That old crystal polished up nicely!
And to such a verdant hue...
Our cosmoport is shiny and new!
At first, I wasn't sure about the gravitational issues here...
Somehow or another, we've made it through.
Our orders are to stay here, eh?
Let's help organize all the sample material.
That alone should keep us busy...
Is it just me, or do these tools feel like old friends by now?
Friends that require regular maintenance...but the same could be said of people, too.
Looking forward to our next job, partner.
Our base is absolutely extravagant!
Just considering what the research team had in mind...
I hear you. Propping up a building is hardly the end of it...
I can't wait to read the research team's latest findings.
I wonder how their analysis fares...
Behold my dance of joy!
Oh gods... \\ So delicious! \\ \\
Slow down, man...
He's like to swallow the bowl itself...
You did a fine job. Now for some well-earned rest.
Full marks!
A gold star for you!
What did I tell you!?
I-I'm sorry... My love for mechs overwhelmed me...
Huhn! Huhn!
Aiming for a new record, are we?

One last time!
Hip-hip...

I've got my eye on you, Wihuwte...
You won't fool us again.
He's using the Endless like pawns!

My countrymen...
Your memories will carry me onward.
As hard as this is, we must push on.
Memories of fear and terror...
An unconscionable act...
Damn you, Calyx!
We see this to the end.
We've beaten you, Calyx.
We did it!
Is that truly the end of it...?
Something doesn't feel right...
Now's our chance!
Calyx has nothing left to throw at us.
A primal of all things...
It won't be the same without Geode around...
We have to stand watch over our supplies.
I still can't believe it...
Nothing to report.
I miss Geode...
This gun is going to Genolt.
It's just too much...
Might be time for a break.
These are the times that test us the most.
I have to submit a requisition form for more parts.
For Geode...
We're developing new high-security arcane circuits.
With these readings, there must be a mother lode underground.
So there's more phainite to be found beneath us...
Ah, to explore is to be alive!
Mech ops always make me nervous...
Leave the handling of the astrodrill to me!
Where's the phainite!?
Good work!
That pilot wasn't half bad.
Layers upon layers of crystalline glass...
What a curious star, this Phaenna.
I'll operate the mech!
An op in a cavern, eh...
Lower the output a notch. Gently, now!
Such power!
Excellent work out there!
Warp loaders are simply the best!
Crystal fragments this way, please!
Submit all materials to the field scanner for analysis!
Mech pilots, break down those corrupted crystals!
The hypercarrot cannons are more formidable than I dared dream...
Bring the ash over here!
The field scanner will root out any hidden spongoi!
Mech pilots, crush those irregular spongoi!
These spongoi don't stand a chance against a warp loader going full throttle!
Deliver the phainite here!
The field scanners remain fully operational on this star as well.
Begin mining from a quicksand pit once you have sufficient ionic energy!
Accumulate ionic energy to begin mining!
Bring the glass fragments here!
Find us some glass clusters, field scanners!
Mech pilots, pulverize the large glass clusters!
Look at the warp loader go!
'Tis crucial to observe the base...
What a spectacle these spectacles make! Ho ho!
Word has it that you've been busy gardenin'.
They're part of the festival, Silvairre. Relax!
I cannot see a godsdamned thing...
Quite a handsome design, wouldn't you say?
Aye, a finer pair of glasses, I've never worn.
Treno is safe. And has been, all this time...
Whatever its flaws, the barrier is keeping the lightning aether at bay.
What of the injured? Are we needed to help heal them?
No more screams... I wager that's a good sign.
Where does it hurt!?
Right h─ Ouch!
These ones're coming along beautifully.
I can handle it! Sure I can!
You don't sound very sure!
Is it over...?
The fight's over. The real work's just begun!
Did you hear? We have visitors!
Ah, Sleepless Rhapsody...
And if the Doomtrain crashes into the shelter!?
How should we celebrate?
Visitors! How many years has it been?
Love a good kick to the tongue after a hard day!
We must prepare for the worst...
A proper carnival, I'd say!
We'll need this cleared away first...
You're a good boy...right? You won't bite...right?
Why is it so long until the tournament? My deck is ready already!
That's one...but where are the other twelve!?
Now this is what I call chic, dahling!
My word! You tell your tales of adventure so...so eloquently!
It seems you've made a friend, little one.
Ook ook!
Hey, hey! This is my kind of party!
And perfect inspiration for my next piece, I might add!
Well, well, well! You're looking fluffy again today!

And I'll protect you!
...Wait. Um.
Treno... I'll always protect you...
O muscles, grow!
O rubble, bugger off!
Then let's get to work!
Ahhh, I feel right as rain!
Leave it to me!
Let's keep our eyes open, shall we?
Oizys is in for a dramatic─albeit brief─shift in conditions.
We need to prepare for the worst.
We need to be ready to act quickly.
Even the heavy equipment is floating! We're going to need gravity generators...
The bubble bloom has brought with it a rare resource─this is our chance to secure new supplies!
Our transports caught the brunt of it... Let's get the cleanup underway!
Rocks have fallen everywhere, just as we feared. Time to deal with the aftermath.
Fantastic work, everyone!
Everything is mostly back in order... Onto cleanup.
We're detecting an increase in local gravity fluctuations!
Our sensors indicate a floating seawater event is in progress.
We've confirmed the approach of a Progenitrix-level extreme low pressure front.
We've confirmed the approach of a Progenitrix-level extreme low pressure front.
What happens if these gravitational phenomena keep getting worse...?
One of those “bubble blooms,” is it?
How will that affect our materials currently en route...?
When the winds hit those crumbling outcrops, we'll be showered with rocks...
Quickly! We need to get this equipment locked down!

Supplies!
Deliver your supplies right here!
That should do it.
Phew... Almost lost my favorite rover!
Please be careful. The gravity in this area is wildly unstable.
Please help resupply our lost materials!

One, two, three...
That should be enough.
Phew, mission accomplished! Time to head back!
Seems the alert's been lifted. We'll take care of the rest!
The red alert is lifted! Many hands made light work!
Is it over, then? Just one last look around to put my mind at ease...
Calling all harvesters! The humid conditions have presented us a unique opportunity!
It's like they've burst through the ground to snatch the bubbles from the air...
Hmm, we could make good use of a material with such superlative hygroscopic properties.
Thank you for responding to the call! Let's collect what we can while we can!
It's not every day a resource like this is found drifting so close to the coast.
The gravity fluctuations are not limited to dry land, it would seem.
How surreal to see spheres of seawater floating above one's head!

Our precious pananoodles...
Please assist with the restocking efforts!
We'd best get this cleared up, and fast...
Fishing those relics out of the water is our main priority!
Of all the terrible luck. That gale cut right across their flight path...
Once we have the relics out of the mud, they're going to need a good scrub.
Please join the work crew and help with clearing the rockfall!

It's so dense...
I'm going to wear out this drill bit in no time.

You can leave this one to me.
Gods, do I love drilling!
Grab your tools and carve us some of this blue ore!
We need all the medical supplies you can contribute!
They set up a depository for medicinal reagents just up ahead.
Yes, this could work in a balm or ointment...
Any contributors should take the elevator to the roof!
Any contributors should take the elevator to the roof!
Any contributors should take the elevator to the roof!
At least some of it survived...
Let's clear that debris!
Someone hand me an axe!
There you are! Don't scare me like that!
You don't smell dodo around here...right?
Hopefully our mechs can handle whatever these anomalies throw at us.
The gravity readings in this area are never stable...
We have repurposed Garlean warmachina now? I'm curious to see how they perform.
We'll have these gravity hiccups sorted in no time!

My tail fur is standing on end...
An effect of the anomaly?
These orbs are so satisfying to pop!
I'm getting the hang of this grav rammer!

Slow and steady.
Let's get these distortions under control.
It's the mother of all gravity orbs!

Oh, I don't like this...
Now my ear fur is twitching.

Ugh...
I may be down, but I'm not out yet.
Wow, that magitek mech is just...wow.
Phew! That was heavy work!
Let's pack it in, everyone!
How do we extract these floatstones from the ground?
Given their anti-gravity properties, they may just extract themselves.
Do we know who the mech pilot is this time...?
First phainite, now floatstone...
Is the mech on its way?
I will master all the science gadgets!

Easy... Eeeasy...
Let the stones come to you...
Seems that for every stone I suck up there are two more!
Feed the field scanners to support the mech efforts!
Deposit all your small floatstones here!
I've never seen so many floatstones...
The field scanners help us pinpoint the bigger rocks up in the sky!
Be ready to use that attractor beam when the signal comes!
Mechs make things so much easier.
Will they ever accept my pilot application?
Thank you! You did a fantastic job!
We could use your help the next time the rocks decide to float!
High score! High score!
You can do it!
One thousand, here I come!
At last, a little peace...
Time to get things done!
Whoops! Slipped again!
“Again”!?
That's a relief...
I can't believe they took that huge thing down!
Mm-hm. Still disgusting though.
Thunderous heavens, I needed that.
\\<gulp> I feel positively reborn!
Leave the bottom half to us! Go up top and reinvigorate that aether!
Leave the bottom half to us! Go up top and reinvigorate that aether!
Leave the bottom half to us! Go up top and reinvigorate that aether!
Leave the bottom half to us! Go up top and reinvigorate that aether!
